narratives.Description: bug(session,release): session:ready reports OK while cache_fresh is dirty, then task release Step 5 fails
narratives.Overview: Spec is Bound remedy lean 5637245965, not the filed body. session:ready prints OK on skip-drift verify while task check later fail-closes on stale-by-drift. Full thread: https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/4399
narratives.Labels: bug, agent-experience, area:cli, area:release, status:child, design-critique:ingest-ready

items.title: Cannot bind until the bar is the check-class evaluate (age + live drift, no --skip-drift-probe), or session:ready verify is specified to use that argv so isCacheFreshFailure then fetch-all can fire. Do not weaken verify:cache-fresh inside task check to match the ritual argv.
Restate AC1 and the test lock around VERIFIED + the skip-drift argv, not around inspect-green after start.
AC2 must key off orientation-dirty / check-class stale-by-drift, distinct from ritual-stale. Substituting the old parallel-prep clause is not done.
Do not auto-defer cache_fresh. Do not fold occupancy (#4266). CHANGELOG.
